hero.caption: This should have been some sort of Lake look out spot, but I couldn't see much water. Edit by Anonymous: This is the railway bridge at the northern end of Lake Menindee. It is crossing the channel that feeds Lake Menindee from Copi Hollow, itself fed by channel from Lake Pamamaroo. As the photo was taken in March 2009 much of the lake was dry due to drought.
